material_rules: Receipt inventory names every case input and parent service record
Assembly service preserves coupon identity and adds assembly/support/aperture/reservoir identities
Bulk-water controls retain distinct no-coupon identity rather than borrowing processed-coupon history
Bifacial and processed/unprocessed comparisons retain distinct coupons
Cleaning changes coupon version and surface-state revision; prior calibrations and wetting baselines cannot be reused
Fresh water creates new lot identity and thermal history; old fluid disposition stays recorded
Evaporated mass and collected condensate have different raw records
Each dependency release must precede child intake and bind matching inventory entry
